name: L0pht Heavy Industries
biography: L0pht Heavy Industries was a hacker collective active between 1992 and 2000 and located in the Boston, Massachusetts area. The L0pht was one of the first viable hackerspaces in the US, and a pioneer of coordinated disclosure. In May, 1998, the group testified in front of a US Senate committee on weak computer security in government where they famously exclaimed they could take down the Internet in 30 minutes.
